observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.unit: primary jobs (persons) with residence and workplace inside the network's half-mile union, counted for the covered fraction of each block
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.coverage_rule: each both_in link counts for cov_h × cov_w, where cov is the share of the block's LAND inside the network half-mile union; a block that only touches a disc does not bring all of its links (the whole-block count above is the upper bound)
depends_on_assumptions: areal_interpolation_land_share (the same convention as the demography and jobs layers)
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.source: jobs package pkg-ed5912a9790d od_summary.both_in_coverage_weighted_S000.JT01 (block cov in block_values.json)
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.note: LODES 2023 job links, not trips; JT00 (all jobs) whole-block count would be 10231

observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.source: demography network dedup R02 = B08301_021 / B08301_001 (ACS 2020-2024)
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.note: residence-based; applied to the residents' end of every link

observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.source: demography network dedup departure_time_bins (B08302) — the 60-minute window with the most departures, over workers not working from home
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.alternative_source_not_acquired: Metromover hourly ridership report (observed) — would REPLACE this parameter, never multiply it

observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.source: demography network dedup R01 = B08301_010 / B08301_001
observed_or_derived_shared_by_all_scenar.role: reference bound for the LOW adoption assumption; NOT part of the multiplication chain

A01_attendance_rate.statement: 85 % of primary-job holders who do not work from home make a commute trip on a typical weekday
A01_attendance_rate.reference: leave/absence and shift patterns are not observed locally; a single value for all scenarios

A02_non_commute_trips_per_commute_trip.statement: non-commute trips inside the network per commute trip
A02_non_commute_trips_per_commute_trip.reference: NHTS national purpose shares show work trips are a minority of person trips; the corridor-relevant fraction and the Miami transfer coefficient are NOT observed — the whole ratio is an assumption

A03_prt_adoption_share_of_all_mode_trips.statement: share of ALL-MODE trips that would use the PRT service
A03_prt_adoption_share_of_all_mode_trips.reference_bound: low must not exceed the observed network public-transportation commute share (R01, ACS)

A04_station_allocation_rule.statement: each block-to-block link is split among the candidate stations at each end in proportion to the block's land share inside each station's half-mile disc, normalised to 1 (conservation by construction)

A05_direction_and_return.statement: AM peak: home -> work; PM peak mirrors the AM peak (boardings <-> alightings); returns equal outbound trips

A06_non_commute_pattern.statement: non-commute trips follow the commute OD pattern and the same station allocation

A07_departure_window_equals_station_wind.statement: the ACS departure-from-home hour is treated as the station arrival hour; B08302 has no return-trip distribution

scenario_rule: low / medium / high change ONLY A02 and A03; A01, A04-A07 and every observed/derived parameter are shared
chain: internal job links -> weekday commute trips -> all-purpose trips -> peak-hour trips -> PRT trips -> station boardings/alightings
not_in_chain: a second peak factor (would double-count with P05)
